title: Housing growth and development levies
policy_question: How should growth-related infrastructure costs be allocated and disclosed so decision-makers can assess impacts on housing delivery, affordability, councils, existing ratepayers, developers and future residents?
decision_owner: To be identified for the selected policy stage

claims.text: The Going for Housing Growth programme is organised around land/planning changes, infrastructure funding and incentives for councils/communities.
The government proposes replacing development contributions with development levies linked to growth-related capital costs.
The ministry says the development-levies bill is being prepared for introduction in Q1 2027 and further input is expected on methodologies/disclosure and through select committee.
The economic burden of a levy may be distributed differently from the entity legally charged; this needs empirical analysis.
The levy design may affect project timing or feasibility under some conditions; direction and magnitude are unknown in this packet.
